exam_scheme.note: The Chartered Accountancy (CA) qualification is governed by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) under the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949. Under the New Scheme of Education and Training (effective from 1st July 2023, examinations launched May 2024), the course is structured into three progressive stages: CA Foundation, CA Intermediate (2 Groups, 6 Papers), and CA Final (2 Groups, 6 Papers), integrated with Self-Paced Online Modules (SPOM Sets A, B, C, D) and mandatory 2-year practical training (Articleship). Passing criteria: minimum 40% in each individual paper and 50% in aggregate for each level/group.

competition_benchmarks.note: Official pass percentage statistics published by the Examination Committee of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) for CA Final and Intermediate examination sessions.

years.selectivity_ratio: May 2024 New Scheme: In CA Final, 35,819 candidates appeared for both groups and 7,122 passed (19.88% pass rate; qualifying as Chartered Accountants). Group I pass rate was 27.35% (74,887 appeared) and Group II was 36.35% (58,891 appeared).
years.source_label: ICAI Press Release — Result of Chartered Accountants Final and Intermediate Examinations held in May 2024

years.selectivity_ratio: November 2023: In CA Final, 32,907 appeared for both groups and 3,099 passed (9.42% pass rate). In CA Intermediate, 53,459 candidates appeared for both groups and 5,204 passed (9.73% pass rate).
years.source_label: ICAI Press Release — Result of Chartered Accountants Final and Intermediate Examination held in November 2023
